title: PR #108: governance: audit organization-wide Git tags and define release policy
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Scope
Audit Git tag refs across all 33 organization repositories and add a machine-readable report plus a proposed tag/release policy.

## Findings
- 33 repositories inspected: 26 not archived, 7 archived.
- Only two Git tags found: `a-townchain-os:v1.0.0` and `atc-standards:v1.1.0`.
- 31 repositories currently have no Git tags.
- The `a-townchain-os:v2.0.0` release remains a draft and no corresponding tag ref was returned.
- Existing tags were not moved/deleted; no new release tags were created because this audit did not establish exact-SHA release acceptance evidence for the untagged repositories.

## Files
- `docs/governance/ATC-ORG-GIT-TAG-AUDIT-001.json`
- `docs/governance/ATC-ORG-GIT-TAG-POLICY-001.md`

## Validation
The JSON was fetched again from the audit branch and parsed successfully: 33 repositories, 2 tag refs, 31 repositories without tags. Policy is a proposal until review/merge. No release tags or releases were published.
